title: Streaming War
titleNative: ストリーミング・ウォー
synopsis: To become a top-notch streamer, a reckless girl named Yoru Kihara, also known as "Angel Hell," earns money through extreme streaming. Thanks to the support of her fans, she managed to save up her target amount to move to the city. However, her abusive parents took everything: her savings and her streaming equipment. In utter despair, Yoru attempts her final act—streaming her own suicide from an abandoned building. But suddenly, she’s attacked by someone wearing a creepy rabbit mask. This marks her fateful encounter with "Streaming War," a grotesque streaming site where underground streamers go to satisfy their insatiable need for recognition!

title: Yueguo Chenshi de Ge
synonyms: The Song That Transcends This World
synopsis: During troubled times, Weng Shaoying is one of the most famous singers in Dongping. Many people go to Song of Fairyland just to see her perform. However, under her glamorous facade, she has been controlled for more than 10 years. On the other side of Dongping is Bi Xing Tang, one of the most famous gangs there. After her father’s death, Yanchu became the young female leader of Bi Xing Tang, which caused a lot of rumors to spread. On one inevitably fortuitous night, the two happened to meet. At that time, neither of them knew that they would eventually become the most important person in the other’s life. Starting from that night onwards, the gears in Shaoying and Yanchu’s fate will forever be rotating together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

synopsis: One day, Charlotte Bennett joins Akito Aoyagi's class as a student studying abroad. Everyone in the class is attracted to Charlotte's beautiful appearance and elegant demeanor, but Akito feels like "we belong in different worlds" and stays away. However, Akito's daily life drastically changes when he rescues Charlotte's younger sister, Emma, when she got lost. He finds out that the Bennett sisters live in the apartment next door to his, and since Emma had taken to Akito, the Bennett sisters start coming over to Akito's place every day. The three of them play dominoes, sit around the dinner table, and go out together. As they spend time together, Akito and Charlotte grow closer, in their own clumsy way… (Source: NicoNico Seiga, translated)
